title: openai-compat: support Responses API variants, seed/determinism flags, and metadata passthrough
author: Priya Desai
description: This PR extends the OpenAI compatibility layer to support the newer Responses-style API variants and the commonly requested determinism features: a seed parameter and deterministic mode. It also ensures arbitrary top-level metadata sent in a request is propagated through the compatibility shim into the internal request context and preserved in logs and telemetry. Motivation: customers have started requesting seamless migration from OpenAI Responses endpoints (responses.create-style payloads) and deterministic generation for reproducible evals. The current shim only covered older completions/chat semantics and dropped unrecognized top-level fields. Changes include: 1) New request mapping logic that accepts 'response' and 'responses' shaped payloads and normalizes to internal call signatures while preserving fields like metadata, user, and seed. 2) A deterministic mode toggle and optional integer seed flow through to the runtime when supported by the model variant; when the backend cannot honor determinism we return a clear capability mismatch error with guidance. 3) Streaming adapter updates to support the new response chunks envelope and ensure stable event order when mixing streaming tokens and tool/function call events. 4) Metadata passthrough plumbing into request_context and debug logs, with opt-in scrubbing based on existing PII configs. 5) Tests and docs: added unit tests for mapping edge cases, integration test that validates metadata propagation to logs, and updated compatibility docs with examples and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: existing OpenAI-compatible calls unchanged; additional fields are optional. Rollout plan: feature-gate behind OPENAI_COMPAT_V2 flag for canary rollout to 10% of traffic, monitor for errors and increased latency. See linked Linear tasks for rollouts and perf validation.
